image_description: A close-up shot of a bright green snake, identified as a green mamba, coiled around a brown tree branch. The snake's head is visible in profile, showing a yellowish-green snout and a dark eye. The body curves behind the branch, displaying vivid emerald green scales on the dorsal side and a pale yellow ventral side. The background is dark and out of focus.

To verify the physical occlusion and wrapping of the snake around the branch, ensuring no fusion artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the scale texture. Real green mambas have very distinct, keeled or smooth scales depending on the exact region, but they should look like individual overlapping plates. AI often smears these into a continuous green skin. Also, verify the eye shape; elapids have round pupils, while vipers have vertical slits. Ensure the classifier distinguishes this from a Green Tree Python (which has heat pits and different head shape).
